title: Takt, the Clumsy Detective
paragraphs: “The culprit’s made one huge mistake. I mean, the fact that they committed this ‘demonstration murder’ means the next murder they’re bound to commit is as obvious as day!”

Saying things like that, Takt seems to have launched a strategy to thwart the crimes in advance by cross-referencing them with the island’s folklore. Hmm… this is going to be a bit of a tricky situation to handle. By the way, you might think that no matter how well I’m hiding, I can’t freely come and go inside the building, but with the wall-passing ability from the Soul Eater Spear, I can easily get inside even if it’s locked. So, I’m going to dance right in front of Takt as he tries to figure things out, fidgeting in frustration.
I’m the culprit! Can you see the culprit with your own eyes?
“Dig up everyone’s alibis and sort them out.”
“Oink!”

Looks like the Pig in the White Coat is sorting out the alibis for the other pigs on Takt’s orders. Alibis? Do you really think the culprit is among you pigs? Too bad! Since I’m the culprit—and I came from outside—alibis are completely meaningless! I wonder who I’ll eliminate next.

Takt’s pale expression is a real treat. I’d love to keep provoking Takt forever, but it’s almost time for my next crime. “While you lot are on vacation… I’ll make sure you taste fear little by little!” Just as I was picking out a suitable pig for tonight’s final slaughter…
“Oooh—”
“Oink—”

The maid pig, out of sight of Takt and the other pigs, poisoned the pig I was supposed to kill, then split the carcass in two with an axe. She’s mimicking the legend, isn’t she? Apparently, there’s some method based on the Seven Star Weapons or something.
This is… a copycat murder! The Maid Pig is killing a pig.
“Oink-oink-hyah-hyah-hyah-hyaaaaaa! Oink-oink-oink-to!”

Eeeeeek… I can sense the vibe this one gives off. I suddenly felt phantom pain in my side, where I’d been stabbed long ago. It’s a sharp, tightening pain! Since I’m not good with deranged pigs, I decided to back off for the time being. Later, when I reported this to Rival,
“Takt underestimated the suppressed woman, didn’t he? Well, Rule—the Seven-Split Demon King—hesitates to lay a hand on those with troubled minds!”

That’s what he said! What on earth does that mean?! Anyway, once I got here, the maid-pig suddenly changed her tune and started tagging along, and we carried out two targeted pig slaughters. Takt, looking at the pigs he’d just taken down, let out a cry of grief and rage, vowing to track down the culprit. As if he hadn’t slept a wink, Takt kept his guard up constantly, both inside the mansion and all around it. But from my perspective, a Ki level like yours is something I can easily slip past.
The next morning, it seems the pigs discovered a shark-pig that had washed up on the beach.
“Are you trying to say that no one who visits the island where the Demon King has been resurrected ever returns…?! Dammit!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!”
Takt was pounding his fist into the ground. Hahahahahaha! Serves you right! By the way, by this point the pigs have become paranoid and are restlessly glancing around, on edge.
“Oink! Oink!”
As if trying to score some brownie points, the Maid Pig placed her hand on Takt’s shoulder and grunted. Is she trying to comfort him? You’re a culprit too, you know.
“Ah… I’ll definitely find the culprit and make them pay! I’m a master detective!”

Shouldn’t that be “amateur detective” instead? He hasn’t even noticed the culprit at all. Of course, Takt hadn’t noticed the mock murders carried out by the maid pig either. It’s enough to make any master detective roll their eyes. A childish mind, a body driven by lust, and the soul of an old man! This is Takt, the reincarnated serial killer!

After that, the storm showed no signs of letting up, and the Maid Pig’s staged murders—as the mastermind—occurred one after another. Changing tactics and methods, and sometimes conspiring with others, the Maid Pig gradually eliminated the other pigs. Since there were even cases where a shooting could be justified by interpretation, it seems the Maid Pig was quite skilled at mystery stories. Or perhaps it’s just that the murder techniques taught directly by Takt—ones that don’t arouse suspicion—have become second nature to him? By the way, I took care of the Shadow Pig from the Takt faction early on. There was a chance he might have found me, after all.
Ah, of course, I’ve been making my own moves as well. I’ve captured a few alive and held them captive as offerings for the Pig King.

Eventually, Rival told me that whispers began to circulate among the pigs—behind Takt’s back—that he might actually be the Seven-Split Demon King. “How could we possibly trust Takt?!” they cried, as they brutally chopped down the island’s trees to build a raft and recklessly set out into the stormy sea.
“Do whatever you want! If anything happens, I won’t protect you!”
“Oink!”
“Oink-oink!”

And so, those foolish pigs, foolish as ever, pressed on into the stormy sea. Of course… Rival and I took care of them! And the paranoia only intensified… but that’s not all. Word has it that Rival mixed diluted Uroboros—a deadly poison—into the pigs’ drinking water, and as a result, they gradually transformed into aggressive beings.

“Stop it, you guys! Calm down! Why are you killing each other? If you keep this up, you’ll be playing right into the Demon King’s hands!　“Calm down! Keep your cool! Just like we always do when we take down those arrogant bastards who don’t know their place!”
Well, Takt tried to reason with them, but it seems the pigs were already so caught up in self-preservation that everyone started looking like an enemy to them.
“Ow! Hey! Don’t hit me—if you don’t cut it out, I’ll kill you!”
It seems Takt’s short fuse was starting to snap.
“Oink!”
“Oink, oink!”

The pigs provoked Takt even further, and in an attempt to overwhelm him with numbers, several of them aimed their guns at him. Just as the maid pig tried to step in front of Takt to protect him, Takt stepped forward.
HAHAHA! You’re all going to die anyway! That’s a phrase often used by the Crimson Swine’s kind, apparently.

“You bastards… If that’s what you’re after, then let’s do this! You bitches who can’t even trust me because you’re too scared for your own skin! I’ll teach you that there’s someone even more terrifying than the Demon King when you piss him off!”
And with that… Takt, overcome by rage, ended up taking out a few of his own pigs.
“If there are multiple perpetrators, the crime is possible!”
That’s just plain foolish! If a detective goes on a killing spree, it’s no longer a mystery!
Meanwhile, as for Father… his days on the island are drawing to a close, and he’s probably having a great time swimming with Filo-tan! HAHAHA!
Well… it’s about time. Rival cast another spell on the island, causing the pig carcasses to suddenly rise and attack.
“O-Ooohhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!?”
As if on cue, the white-coated pig that had been investigating was struck by Rival’s magic and began transforming into a monster right before Takt’s eyes.
“Oink!”
The maid pig took down the lab-coat pig as it transformed into a monster and lunged at her. She’s truly become a pig-slaying demon, with no hesitation left when it comes to killing her own kind.
“W-What the hell is this?! D-Does that mean the Demon King actually exists?!”
“Ooogggghhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!? Vaaaaaaah…”

And so, the dead pigs kept attacking the other pigs one after another, and the number of zombie pigs just kept growing. Of course, there were also pigs that had become Apostles of Ouroboros, and Takt must have thought the island had turned into a hellish scene of utter chaos. The pigs scattered across the island and began running for their lives, fleeing from monsters, zombies, and the Apostles of Ouroboros.
“This is bullshit! I’m the strongest hero! Take this!”

Takt, refusing to back down, drew his whip and began slaughtering the zombies and monsters, but… things didn’t go quite as planned. From behind him—where he’s completely exposed—I approach with the Cloaking Lance and chant:
“The Love Hunter commands. Holy Weapons. Vassal Weapons. Answer The Love Hunter’s call, break free from the shackles of foolish power, and awaken!”
“W-What!? My strength is draining away! Who the hell are you!?”

All seven of the Seven Star Weapons Takt was holding—including the throwing weapon he’d just unveiled at this special event—slipped from his grasp and flew straight toward me. …And then—the Sleep Lance.
“Gua—”
Before Takt even had a chance to look at me, his Seven Star Weapons were snatched away, and he lost consciousness.
“Bubuhi! Buhu-to-buhihi-buhihi!”
The deranged maid pig aimed her rifle at me.
“Do you really have time to worry about Takt? To be honest, I’ve never liked you, so this is a good outcome.”
“Oink… Oinkyaaaaaa!?”
That’s right—just then, a horde of zombie pigs swarmed right behind the maid pig, and she met her end by joining their ranks.
“Blah, blah, blah. I got the claw!”
Damn Rival! He snatched the claw—which might have become Filo-tan’s after I stripped it from her—right from my blind spot.
“Well then, Spear Hero, this event is almost over… All that’s left is recording the epilogue, so let’s wrap this up.”

When my rival snapped his fingers, the zombies crumbled to dust, and some of the monster-fied pigs returned to normal, while the rest seemed to just keep killing each other. As for those who had become Apostles of Ouroboros, I took care of them with my Brionac and Prominence.
A few hours later… Takt woke up in the bed of his own large bedroom in the mansion, which was now completely empty. His Rival had already dispersed the storm, and peace had returned to the island.
“Is this… my room? Was it all just a dream? No…”

Realizing that the Seven Star Weapons that should have been in his hand were missing, Takt seemed to understand that this wasn’t a dream. At the same time, he looked with disgust at the object hanging in the room.
“You want me to hang myself?! Don’t mess with me!”
I had set up a rope for hanging, but it seems he didn’t like it.
“Everyone! Hey!”

And so, Takt wandered all over the island. His face was contorted with terror as he saw the traces of the pigs’ battle and their corpses. HAHAHA, that’s the look I wanted to see! Eventually, Takt made his way to the clock tower built on the mansion grounds. Well, I did make sure to arrange the pigs’ corpses in an unnatural way, after all.
“So it’s you… You’re the one who wanted to do this!”
I was standing with my back to Takt, looking out at the scenery, when he braced himself and spat out those murderous words at me.
“What do you think? This is your blood-soaked end and the true nature of a pig. Honestly, I’d like to see you tremble with fear even more… The terror has only just begun, you know?”
“What the hell are you talking about!”

That’s right… Takt originally cut off all contact with the outside world during the Spirit Tortoise incident and has been wallowing in carnal desires here, giving in to every whim. He’s a piece of Trash that makes me want to puke. And this is happening right in the middle of a Wave! Is he an idiot? Of course, according to my Rival, it seems he had various relevant parties identify the other Seven Star Weapons wielders. Either way, this is a fitting end for a fool who spends his time leisurely vacationing on an isolated island while a crisis rages in the world!
“I know there’s no point in trying to reason with you, Rival.”
“Nope-pee.”

With a whoosh, Rival descends and transforms into Takt’s dragon form. To give a spoiler: when he took down the fox and the griffin, Rival had each of their corpses hold a key to create sealed rooms. Ultimately, Rival swallowed an egg for a new body, transferred from Takt’s Dragon into it, hatched inside his own belly, and then burst out to kill Takt’s Dragon.
“R-Raildia!? So you were the culprit all along!”
“Hehehe… yeees.”
Takt is glaring at me with murderous intent. I can tell now. That’s the look of someone who thinks his partner has been stolen away.

I’m truly taken aback. What on earth would make me want to steal Takt’s dragon?! But Rival said this would get to Takt, so I’m just going along with it and watching. I must admit, it does feel a tiny bit good!
“That’s the look I wanted to see!”

If the other person were my Father, I’d be desperately denying it. Ah, my Father… I am a sinful man. I absolutely must atone for this. Takt is a different story, though. But I’d really, from the bottom of my heart, prefer not to be seen as a man who steals another’s lover.
“Takt, do you know who the culprit is? If you’re right, I’ll kill you without making you suffer.”
“Shut the hell up! I’ll kill you! Uoooooooooooooooooo!”
With that, Takt, his face flushed with rage, clenched his fists and charged toward me.
“I’ll have to make you suffer even more, so here—Paralyze Lance X!”
“Gwaa—kuuuuuuu… Ooooh…”
“Hell has only just begun, you know. Drenched in hatred… Die!”
And so, we apprehended Takt and took him away. It was quite a sight to see the foolish Takt’s face contorted with fear. He’ll never be able to atone for the sins of tormenting the Filolial-sama!
“Former criminal, aren’t you going to confess here, just as the textbook says?”
“Yeah… you killed countless Filolial-sama in another world… there’s no way I’d go along with that!”
This is exactly why Rival is such a hassle.

And so, after secretly capturing Takt and taking him to the Pig King—who had already coordinated his story with us—the deal to gather and present the pigs that had been with Takt was already complete. I’ve heard that even the lights of the Seven Stars Church haven’t changed outwardly, thanks to my Rival and the cultists colluding. I’ve already learned that if I don’t gather and dispose of Takt’s pigs, it’ll be a massive hassle. The plan was for pigs from all over to hear Takt’s voice and head to the Pig King’s lair one after another.

The former commotion on Seven Island has faded, and silence has returned. If the Demon King of Immortality truly existed, he would likely have been destroyed by the God Hunters—that’s what my Father from the First World would say. Let’s allow the Demon King, who was brought into this world for no good reason, to rest in peace at last.
Oh? I feel like Ren and Itsuki, when we headed to Faubrey, would say, “What’s a murderer doing wallowing in sentimentality!” Well, I suppose it’s just my imagination.
And so, the Seven Island Incident came to an end.
